name: Imputed Righteousness
overview: Scripture reveals that righteousness is not earned by works but is credited to the believer through faith in God, who justifies the ungodly. Romans teaches that the righteous live by faith and that God imputes righteousness apart from works, as exemplified in the blessedness described by David. Philippians further clarifies that this righteousness is not based on the law or human effort, but is the righteousness of God received through faith in Christ.
